documents.name: journal-entries
documents.summary: Journal entries, and the journal entry of every transaction
documents.label: number

filters.help: only entries with this status: draft, posted or void
only the entries of this transaction type (journal is an entry made by hand)

documents.deleteHelp: Only a draft can be deleted. Void a posted journal entry with `void`: it stays in the books with its number, and its amounts no longer count.

fields.name: date
fields.help: the date of the entry, as YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: memo
fields.help: a note for the whole entry

fields.name: auto_reverse_on
fields.help: a date, as YYYY-MM-DD: Books posts the reversing entry on that day

fields.name: status
fields.help: draft, posted or void; `add --post`, `post` and `void` change it

fields.name: doc_type
fields.help: the transaction type the entry belongs to; journal for an entry made by hand

fields.name: origin
fields.help: how the entry came to be; document for the entry Books writes for a transaction

fields.name: document
fields.help: the id of the transaction Books wrote the entry for

fields.name: number
fields.help: the entry number; Books gives it when the entry is posted

fields.name: total
fields.help: the sum of the debits, in cents; Books computes it

fields.name: revision
fields.help: the count of saves; the commands send it so two callers cannot overwrite each other

fields.name: replaces
fields.help: the posted entry this one corrects; `edit` of a posted entry sets it

fields.name: debit
fields.help: the debit, in cents; a line has a debit or a credit

fields.name: credit
fields.help: the credit, in cents; a line has a debit or a credit

fields.name: customer
fields.help: the customer of a line on an accounts receivable account

fields.name: vendor
fields.help: the vendor of a line on an accounts payable account
